sections.advice: Cueva del Niño → Solana del molinico is 36 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Solana del molinico → La Risca I is 16 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

places-cueva-del-nino-la-risca-i-2.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-cueva-del-nino-la-risca-i-2.story: 112 km from Ayna to Ayna, about 1 h 56 of riding. It goes by way of Solana del molinico, La Risca I and back through Solana del molinico. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
